# Resource library

[← Main guide](../README.md)

Select resources by task and prerequisites. Editorial review is not a guarantee of availability or independent validation.

Collection reviewed: 2026-10-20.

- [The Python Tutorial](https://docs.python.org/3/tutorial/) — Documentation · Beginner · Free · English. The official language tutorial. Use it as a reference while writing small scripts rather than reading everything before practicing.
  - Prerequisites: Some general programming familiarity; complete beginners can start with a guided lesson.

- [R for Data Science, second edition](https://r4ds.hadley.nz/) — Book · Beginner · Free online · English. A practical route through importing, transforming, visualizing, and communicating tabular data in R.
  - Prerequisites: No prior R experience.

- [Data Carpentry: genomics lessons](https://datacarpentry.org/lessons/#genomics) — Tutorial · Beginner · Free · English. Learn project organization, the command line, sequence processing, and computing through biological examples.
  - Prerequisites: No prior command-line experience for the introductory lessons.

- [Elzero: Mastering Python](https://elzero.org/category/courses/mastering-python/) — Course · Beginner · Free · Arabic. An Arabic-language programming entry point retained from the original resource list. Pair the lessons with a small biological data task.
  - Prerequisites: No prior Python experience.

- [Ensembl training](https://training.ensembl.org/) — Tutorial · Beginner · Free · English. Learn to navigate genome annotation, identifiers, comparative data, and Ensembl tools using worked training materials.
  - Prerequisites: Basic genetics.

- [NCBI Learn](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/learn/) — Tutorial · Beginner · Free · English. Find official introductions and training for NCBI databases and tools; choose a tutorial that matches your data source.
  - Prerequisites: Basic molecular biology.

- [AnnData documentation](https://anndata.readthedocs.io/en/stable/) — Documentation · Intermediate · Free · English. Understand the annotated matrix structure used in many Python single-cell workflows, including observations, variables, and layers.
  - Prerequisites: Python and basic single-cell matrices.

- [PDB-101: understanding PDB data](https://pdb101.rcsb.org/learn/guide-to-understanding-pdb-data/introduction) — Guide · Beginner · Free · English. A welcoming introduction to structure files, experimental information, assemblies, and interpretation.
  - Prerequisites: Basic protein biology.

- [Statistical Thinking for the 21st Century](https://statsthinking21.github.io/statsthinking21-core-site/) — Book · Beginner · Free online · English. Develop statistical reasoning about data, probability, inference, and models before relying on a test by name.
  - Prerequisites: Basic arithmetic and willingness to work through examples.

- [Bioconductor: gene-level RNA-seq workflow](https://bioconductor.org/packages/release/workflows/html/rnaseqGene.html) — Workflow · Intermediate · Free · English. Connect RNA-seq processing with exploratory analysis and differential expression through a documented workflow.
  - Prerequisites: Basic R, sample metadata, and introductory statistics.

- [Single-cell Best Practices](https://www.sc-best-practices.org/) — Book · Intermediate · Free online · English. A question-oriented reference for single-cell analysis across modalities, including preprocessing, statistics, and integration.
  - Prerequisites: Basic Python or R and single-cell biology.

- [Software Carpentry: Version Control with Git](https://swcarpentry.github.io/git-novice/) — Tutorial · Beginner · Free · English. Practice tracking changes, working with remote repositories, and collaborating on a small project.
  - Prerequisites: Basic command-line use.

- [Conda: managing environments](https://docs.conda.io/projects/conda/en/latest/user-guide/tasks/manage-environments.html) — Documentation · Beginner · Free · English. Create and document isolated software environments, including environment files that can be shared with collaborators.
  - Prerequisites: Basic command-line use.

- [Quarto: getting started](https://quarto.org/docs/get-started/) — Tutorial · Beginner · Free · English. Combine analysis, narrative, and outputs in a reproducible report rather than copying results into an unrelated document.
  - Prerequisites: Basic R or Python for executable examples.

- [MIT OpenCourseWare: Linear Algebra](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/18-06-linear-algebra-spring-2010/) — Course · Intermediate · Free · English. A deeper route into matrices, projections, and related concepts that support PCA and machine learning.
  - Prerequisites: Algebra; consult the course's own prerequisite guidance.

- [Dive into Deep Learning](https://d2l.ai/) — Book · Intermediate · Free online · English. Build conceptual and practical foundations in deep learning; select chapters relevant to the model you are studying.
  - Prerequisites: Python, probability, linear algebra, and basic calculus for deeper chapters.

- [RCSB PDB: learning resources](https://www.rcsb.org/) — Database · Beginner · Free · English. Find experimental structures and inspect entry-specific methods, sequence information, and validation evidence.
  - Prerequisites: Basic protein biology.

- [UCSF ChimeraX tutorials](https://www.rbvi.ucsf.edu/chimerax/tutorials.html) — Tutorial · Beginner · Tutorials free; software terms vary by use · English. Learn molecular visualization through worked examples; check the current software license for your intended use.
  - Prerequisites: Basic structural biology.

- [Biopython Tutorial and Cookbook](https://biopython.org/docs/latest/Tutorial/) — Documentation · Intermediate · Free · English. Practical biological sequence and structure handling, including parsers used in the protein-structure starter project.
  - Prerequisites: Basic Python.

- [EMBL-EBI: AlphaFold practical guide](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/training/online/courses/alphafold/) — Course · Intermediate · Free · English. Learn access routes, interpretation, strengths, limitations, and confidence assessment for predicted structures.
  - Prerequisites: Basic protein structure knowledge.

- [Interpreting AlphaFold confidence scores](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/training/online/courses/alphafold/inputs-and-outputs/evaluating-alphafolds-predicted-structures-using-confidence-scores/) — Guide · Intermediate · Free · English. Understand local confidence and relative-domain uncertainty before using a prediction to support a biological claim.
  - Prerequisites: Protein structure basics.

- [ColabFold](https://github.com/sokrypton/ColabFold) — Tool · Intermediate · Code free; compute access varies · English. An accessible prediction toolkit with examples and execution options. Check current compute availability before planning a run.
  - Prerequisites: Structure prediction basics and familiarity with notebooks or command-line tools.

- [RFdiffusion](https://github.com/RosettaCommons/RFdiffusion) — Tool · Advanced · Code available; GPU compute may cost · English. Explore diffusion-based protein backbone generation and conditional design through the authors' code and examples.
  - Prerequisites: Protein design, structure assessment, and command-line experience.

- [ProteinMPNN](https://github.com/dauparas/ProteinMPNN) — Tool · Advanced · Code available; compute may cost · English. Study sequence design conditioned on a protein backbone as a distinct stage in a broader design workflow.
  - Prerequisites: Protein structures, sequence design, and scripting.

- [OpenMM user guide](https://docs.openmm.org/latest/userguide/) — Documentation · Advanced · Free; compute may cost · English. Learn simulation setup, execution, and analysis with explicit attention to the physical model and settings.
  - Prerequisites: Molecular simulation basics and Python.

- [GROMACS documentation](https://manual.gromacs.org/current/) — Documentation · Advanced · Free; compute may cost · English. A reference for molecular dynamics methods, file formats, commands, and reproducible simulation configuration.
  - Prerequisites: Thermodynamics, molecular structures, and command-line use.

- [DESeq2 vignette](https://bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/vignettes/DESeq2/inst/doc/DESeq2.html) — Documentation · Intermediate · Free · English. Understand count-based differential expression, model design, contrasts, diagnostics, and interpretation.
  - Prerequisites: R and experimental design.

- [Galaxy Training Network](https://training.galaxyproject.org/) — Tutorial · Beginner · Training free; server quotas vary · English. Hands-on biological analysis tutorials across sequencing, proteomics, metabolomics, and other domains.
  - Prerequisites: Choose an introductory pathway; many require no programming.

- [nf-core/rnaseq](https://nf-co.re/rnaseq) — Workflow · Intermediate · Code free; compute and storage may cost · English. A production workflow to examine after a smaller tutorial; learn its inputs, profiles, QC outputs, and documented options.
  - Prerequisites: RNA-seq concepts, Nextflow, and suitable compute access.

- [Scanpy tutorials](https://scanpy.readthedocs.io/en/stable/tutorials/index.html) — Tutorial · Intermediate · Free · English. Work through Python single-cell analysis examples and inspect how preprocessing decisions affect downstream results.
  - Prerequisites: Basic Python and single-cell matrices.

- [Seurat guided clustering tutorial](https://satijalab.org/seurat/articles/pbmc3k_tutorial.html) — Tutorial · Intermediate · Free · English. An R entry point to single-cell QC, normalization, dimensionality reduction, clustering, and marker exploration.
  - Prerequisites: Basic R and single-cell concepts.

- [scvi-tools tutorials and model guides](https://docs.scvi-tools.org/en/stable/) — Documentation · Advanced · Free; compute may cost · English. Choose probabilistic models by task and modality, and read their assumptions alongside the worked tutorials.
  - Prerequisites: Python, single-cell analysis, and statistics.

- [totalVI: RNA and protein analysis](https://docs.scvi-tools.org/en/stable/user_guide/models/totalvi.html) — Guide · Advanced · Free; compute may cost · English. A model guide for joint RNA–protein analysis, with links to CITE-seq examples and discussion of the observation model.
  - Prerequisites: CITE-seq concepts, Python, and single-cell QC.

- [MultiVI: RNA and chromatin accessibility](https://docs.scvi-tools.org/en/stable/user_guide/models/multivi.html) — Guide · Advanced · Free; compute may cost · English. Study joint RNA–chromatin accessibility modeling, including the paired and unpaired data setting.
  - Prerequisites: Single-cell RNA/ATAC concepts and Python.

- [MuData documentation](https://mudata.scverse.org/latest/) — Documentation · Intermediate · Free · English. Understand how multimodal observations and modality-specific matrices are organized and linked.
  - Prerequisites: Python and AnnData.

- [Pertpy: perturbation analysis](https://pertpy.scverse.org/en/stable/) — Tutorial · Advanced · Free; compute may cost · English. Explore guide assignment, perturbation efficacy, response comparisons, and prediction through documented examples.
  - Prerequisites: Single-cell analysis and experimental design.

- [Scirpy: immune receptor analysis](https://scirpy.scverse.org/en/latest/) — Tutorial · Advanced · Free · English. Learn repertoire QC, clonotype analysis, and integration of receptor information with cell-level measurements.
  - Prerequisites: Python, single-cell data, and basic immunology.

- [AIRR Community documentation](https://docs.airr-community.org/en/stable/) — Documentation · Intermediate · Free · English. Use community terminology, data standards, and metadata guidance when handling receptor repertoire datasets.
  - Prerequisites: Basic adaptive immune repertoire concepts.

- [Mass spectrometry basics — Lennart Martens](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bS78rIYvFBE&list=PLXxp6nsBenSX_W8DiOocKJ0laNauYNdYl&index=1) — Video series · Beginner · Free · English. An introduction to mass spectrometry for proteomics, starting with amino acids and proteins and covering ion sources, analyzers, detectors, tandem mass spectrometry, and peptide fragmentation.
  - Prerequisites: Basic protein biology and chemistry; no programming required.

- [EMBL-EBI on-demand training](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/training/on-demand) — Course · Beginner · Free · English. Find focused introductions to biological databases and analysis areas, including routes into additional omics fields.
  - Prerequisites: Vary by course.

- [Nextflow documentation](https://docs.seqera.io/nextflow) — Documentation · Intermediate · Free; compute may cost · English. Reference processes, channels, modules, profiles, executors, and dependency handling while building a small pipeline.
  - Prerequisites: Command-line use and workflow concepts.

- [Nextflow community training](https://training.nextflow.io/) — Course · Intermediate · Free · English. A guided route from running a first pipeline to composing and configuring workflows.
  - Prerequisites: Basic shell skills; start with the introductory material.

- [nf-core documentation](https://nf-co.re/docs/) — Documentation · Intermediate · Free · English. Learn conventions for using and developing community pipelines, including configuration and contribution guidance.
  - Prerequisites: Nextflow basics.

- [Snakemake documentation](https://snakemake.readthedocs.io/en/stable/) — Documentation · Intermediate · Free; compute may cost · English. Understand rules, file dependencies, software environments, execution, and reporting.
  - Prerequisites: Basic Python and command-line use.

- [Snakemake general-use tutorial](https://snakemake.readthedocs.io/en/stable/tutorial/tutorial.html) — Tutorial · Intermediate · Free · English. Build and extend an example workflow while learning dependency handling, configuration, and execution.
  - Prerequisites: Basic Python and shell use.

- [Apptainer user guide](https://apptainer.org/docs/user/latest/) — Documentation · Intermediate · Free; infrastructure may cost · English. Learn container execution and reproducibility concepts relevant to shared research computing systems.
  - Prerequisites: Linux and software environment basics.

- [Google Machine Learning Crash Course](https://developers.google.com/machine-learning/crash-course) — Course · Intermediate · Free · English. An applied introduction to model fitting, generalization, data handling, and evaluation.
  - Prerequisites: Python and introductory algebra/statistics; check module guidance.

- [Developing Software with Generative AI](https://carpentries-incubator.github.io/software-development-with-genai/) — Tutorial · Intermediate · Free · English. Practice AI-assisted software development through a research-computing lesson. The material is under development; check its current status and verify generated code.
  - Prerequisites: Some programming experience; this is an evolving Carpentries Incubator lesson.

- [Hugging Face LLM course](https://huggingface.co/learn/llm-course/chapter1/1) — Course · Intermediate · Free; optional compute may cost · English. Understand language models and their practical ecosystem; pair technical learning with source verification and task-level checks.
  - Prerequisites: Python and introductory machine learning for implementation chapters.

- [Hugging Face Agents Course](https://huggingface.co/learn/agents-course/unit0/introduction) — Course · Advanced · Course free; external services may cost · English. An introduction to agent concepts, tools, and implementation. Evaluate any example on a bounded scientific task before expanding it.
  - Prerequisites: Python, APIs, and basic LLM familiarity.

- [Ten simple rules for using large language models in science](https://journals.plos.org/ploscompbiol/article?id=10.1371/journal.pcbi.1011767) — Paper · Beginner · Open access · English. A science-specific starting point for transparent, critical LLM use, with discussion of verification and appropriate applications.
  - Prerequisites: A scientific task you want to support with an LLM.

- [BindCraft](https://github.com/martinpacesa/BindCraft) — Tool · Advanced · Code available; dependency licenses and GPU costs vary · English. An optimization-based binder-design pipeline combining AlphaFold-based design, sequence design, and filtering. Compare its strategy with diffusion-based approaches and inspect dependency terms.
  - Prerequisites: Binder design, structure assessment, and suitable GPU access.
